commits.message:
docs(design): the isolated daemon, tmux events and browser surface designs

Goals, architecture, contracts and one document per area, with the surveys and probes behind them. The Frame is recorded as built, and the browser surface is un-parked.
test(rig): the parse cache keys on each registered domain's members, rigs that seed an origin draw as that session, and the testing memory line is true again (candybar-testing-ihvy.4k6)
test(rig): the parse cache keys on the registered option domains (candybar-testing-ihvy.4k6)
test(rig): review fixes — undo-redo keeps its seeded origin, rig records its cwd, configure-mode keeps width 200 (candybar-testing-ihvy.4k6)

test(rig): 26 more test files build through buildRig, and buildRuntime is gone (candybar-testing-ihvy.4k6)

Each file keeps its own vocabulary as a thin wrapper over buildRig and no longer repeats the parse, store, registry, compile, draw and click assembly.

test(rig): buildRig assembles a render rig with a default for every field (candybar-testing-ihvy.4k6)

Foundation: test/helpers/rig.ts, its test, colour-256's measurement helpers in their own module, and dsl-groups, dsl-picker and colour-256 on the rig.
fix(bar-pane): a frame overwrites its rows and lands whole, so the pane stops flickering

refactor(time): the daemon reads time and schedules work through one Timekeeper (candybar-testing-ihvy.aiy) (#586)

* feat(time): one Timekeeper port with a real clock and a held one, proven by one contract suite (candybar-testing-ihvy.aiy)

* refactor(time): the launcher, log, limits, lane edge, session storage and update watch run on a Timekeeper they are handed (candybar-testing-ihvy.aiy)

* refactor(time): the variable store, render cache and run stats read the daemon's clock (candybar-testing-ihvy.aiy)

* refactor(time): every timer, wall reading and loop turn in src goes through the Timekeeper, and lint keeps it so (candybar-testing-ihvy.aiy)

* refactor(time): a launcher carries the machine's clock for whoever waits on its children, and memory and the plan name the two timekeepers (candybar-testing-ihvy.aiy)

* refactor(time): the clock lint also bans process.hrtime, process.uptime and node:perf_hooks (candybar-testing-ihvy.aiy)
